text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After training was over, as I was tidying 
up the equipment we used...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*... This time... I'm still 
far from... the formula for victory, it 
seems.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
However—that is precisely why it's so 
entertaining...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
She is someone who stays true to her 
beliefs through theory. And I am someone 
who stays true to my ideals through 
supremacy.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, such an appearance is worthy of 
admiration. ...Though, of course, the most 
truly beautiful one is me.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Her beautiful figure, unmatched by anyone. 
Wouldn't you like to see it too?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Those eyes staring straight at me burned 
with a fire that seemed to say she could 
still run...
choice_data_list: Let's take a break for now.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... We don't need many words between 
us, do we?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Then let us begin anew. Our march along 
the path of supremacy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Inspired and fired up, T.M. Opera O and I 
continued extra training until she was 
completely satisfied.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ho? So you're saying you have no desire to 
witness the "Conqueror's" advance?
choice_data_list:
An advance requires vitality above all 
else.

An advance requires vitality above all 
else.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"...In other words, you're telling me I 
should rest these fine legs for now?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, that makes sense. These legs that 
walk the path of supremacy deserve to be 
polished in a rose bath.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Letting that burning heart float among 
roses in the bath, T.M. Opera O rested 
both mind and body...
